summary: UCSF's June 2025 presentation to the Mission Bay Citizens Advisory Committee lists Block 18B, with a use of parking, among the undeveloped parcels remaining under its Long Range Development Plan; the same slide says UCSF has no building plans at Mission Bay right now.

facts.value: Parking (UCSF Long Range Development Plan use for Block 18B, as listed on slide 3 of the June 2025 presentation)

sources.title: UCSF Mission Bay Planned Development (presentation to the Mission Bay Citizens Advisory Committee, June 12, 2025)
sources.publisher: UCSF, presented to OCII Mission Bay Citizens Advisory Committee

sources.title: Attachment 1: Mission Bay Land Use Map (December 2019)
sources.publisher: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII)

open_questions: No project, developer, architect, design or schedule for Block 18B was found in any source read. The only text read is a one-line list entry in the UCSF presentation.

The slide's map labels (including the 'future parking garage' label the geometry file mentions) are part of the slide image; only the slide's text list was read as text, and only that list is cited here.

OCII's December 2019 Land Use Map text shows plan blocks 18A and 18B on this row and no 18C, while UCSF's 2025 list uses 18A, 18B and 18C. Which UCSF block corresponds to which OCII plan block (and so which polygon is 18B) was not resolved from text.
Whether the site is a surface parking lot today rests on this project's own imagery check; no source read says so.
